messages:
maria: quick heads-up: a customer reported writes blocked after a proxy rotation. client kept same sticky cookie but backendaffinity moved regions, legal check failed. anyone seen similar?
ajay: saw this once in a canary. rotation moved pods across nodes; instance tags changed while cookies stayed.
leila: are we still doing the fast-rotate (no-drain) mode in clusters with residency rules?
samir: fast-rotate is default for speed, assumes ephemeral cookies + idempotency. clearly a gap when server-side residency enforcement exists.
maria: root cause summary: client sticky key -> proxy instance mapping persisted. proxy instance got rescheduled to another AZ/region tag, so the cookie pointed to a proxy whose backing region no longer matched the residency claim. server-side legal guard rejected the write.
ajay: short-term mitigation idea: mark tenants with residency==STRICT and force-drain rotations for those only. low blast radius.
leila: +1. medium-term: include an immutable "residency-claim" in session state rather than relying on instance tags. header or signed cookie.
samir: if we sign a blob we need TTL + replay protection. control plane should mint leases, proxies validate locally (ed25519 verify). TTL short (2-5m) to reduce window.
maria: proposal: implement 'x-residency-lease: <base64-sig>' header. control plane issues leases on session creation and on explicit handoffs. proxies check lease.region == proxy.region and lease.valid. 
ajay: perf note: signature verification per-request might be heavy. but if proxies cache verified leases for their session IDs we can amortize. ed25519 verify is cheap though.
leila: ops asks for observability: lease-mismatch counter, lease-expiry histogram, issuer-rotation alerts. legal wants explicit region taxonomy in RFC.
samir: key rotation: proxies should fetch current public keys periodically (pull) and fall back to old keys for a short overlap. if key missing, default policy per-cluster: EU clusters default-deny, global default-allow-with-audit.
maria: hybrid policy sounds sane. also add a canary mode: start with "log-only" for 48h then flip to enforce for a subset of tenants.
ajay: I can spike a small proxy-side lib to verify ed25519 blobs and a tiny cache (LRU by session). estimate 2d.
samir: I'll spec the lease issuer API, sequence for a rotation (issue new lease, drain old sessions, swap backing), and operator rollback steps in case of accidental denies.
leila: I'll coordinate compliance wheels: define what counts as a region (cloud region vs legal jurisdiction) and acceptable TTLs. we should avoid leases that encode PII.
sre-bot: Canary run summary: staging fast-rotate caused 0.14% residency mismatches; automated rollback triggered.
maria: next actions: RFC draft for "residency leases" with sequence diagram (maria), proxy lib prototype (ajay), control-plane issuer + runbook (samir), compliance notes (leila). I'll open ops PR to force-drain on residency==STRICT today.
leila: Also add a telemetry dashboard tile for "residency_mismatch_rate" and an alert at 0.1% over 5m for high-traffic clusters.
ajay: will throw together a PoC repo link once prototype compiles.
samir: will include load test numbers (latency of verify + cache hit rate) in RFC appendix.
maria: thanks team. I'll post RFC link in this thread within 48h. :thumbsup:
